transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Getting out of breath going up the stairs.
When did you first notice getting out of breath going up the stairs?
It's come on slowly, over about three months.
Have you ever had an allergy or a bad reaction to any medicine?
My wife's the one who remembers all that.
How much does getting out of breath going up the stairs affect your day-to-day life?
I have to stop halfway up the stairs to get my breath.
Could you tell me what medicines you take regularly these days, including anything you've started recently?
I take bisoprolol once a day.
Have you ever stayed in a hospital overnight for any reason?
My son drove me to the hospital last year for a scan.
When you get out of breath going up the stairs, do you notice any other symptoms at the same time?
My ankles get a bit puffy in the evenings.
Where do you notice it most when you get out of breath going up the stairs?
Just the breathlessness, no chest pain or anything.
How often do you notice getting out of breath when you go up the stairs?
Every time I go up them, but not when I'm sitting.
When you get out of breath going up the stairs, where do you feel it most, and does it stay there or spread anywhere — in your chest, in your throat, somewhere else, or are you not sure?
Just puffed out all over, nowhere in particular.
What worries you most about getting out of breath when you go up the stairs?
Worried my heart might be getting worse.
When you feel puffed out going up the stairs, how would you describe that feeling?
Just can't seem to get enough air in.
Aside from the hospital scan last year, is there anything else about your past health you’d like to add?
I've got atrial fibrillation. Had it five years now.
Other than the bisoprolol you take once a day, is there anything else you’d like to add about your medicines?
There's the rivaroxaban too, with my evening meal.
Is there anything else you’ve noticed along with getting out of breath that you’d like to add?
I use two pillows now instead of one.
Have you had any operations in the past you’d like to add?
Had a heart attack about twelve years ago.
Are there any other medicines you take, or any recent changes to your medicines, that you’d like to add?
There's atorvastatin, I take that at night.
When you get out of breath, is there anything else that happens at the same time?
Reminds me of my brother, he had a bad heart.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
